BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 3, 2026, it purchased 92,015 of its ordinary shares across various trading venues, with an aggregate volume-weighted average price of $113.2444. These repurchases are part of CRH's ongoing share buyback program, which aims to repurchase up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026. Following these transactions and subsequent cancellation, CRH will have 669,784,329 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.053% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 4 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 3 rd March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 669,784,329 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.053% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
